description: Describes Open-End Response Analyser: AI coding of open-ended survey responses into a three-level category hierarchy (L1-L3, a code frame), assignment of every response, results and exports. Returns the workflow, input limits, current analysis models, how to authenticate and how billing works. Use it first when the user asks what the tool can do or how to analyse, code or categorise open-ended answers. No account needed; reads nothing personal.
name: open_end_get_capabilities
title: Get Open-End Analyser capabilities
